controls.label: Tool
controls.hint: What is in hand: a scythe to mow with, a torch to set the grass alight, or a ball to throw and roll.

controls.label: Time
controls.hint: The hour of the day: the sun rises at 6, is highest at 13 and sets at 20.

controls.label: Wind
controls.hint: How hard the wind blows. Fire runs before it.

controls.label: Regrow
controls.hint: Cut grass grows back over about a minute.

controls.label: Quality
controls.hint: Auto follows Patch's performance mode; lower draws fewer blades.

triggers.label: Reset
triggers.hint: The meadow as it grew: nothing trodden, cut or burnt.
